shared_elements: low-relief carved figures on a stone block/monolith
a circular disc or drilled circular element on the surface
justification: Both surfaces show shallow relief carvings of schematic animal/creature forms on a large stone block, with figures loosely organised in horizontal bands and a conspicuous circular element (an incised ring on A, a drilled round hole on B), which is only a generic correspondence. The biggest difference in content is that A is a shaped anthropomorphic monolith with a head, torso and frontal chest ornament bearing face-like and body-related motifs, while B presents a repeating frieze of profile quadrupeds/reptilian creatures with no human figure or body-shaped support.
